title: Austin: Speed Limits, Internet, Growth
summary:
*   **Major Highway Speed Limits:** Set new 55 mph speed limits on key highways including Mopac, I-35, Loop 360, and Highways 183/290 within city limits, also directing further study for potentially higher speeds.
*   **Urban Expansion & Downtown Future:** Approved the annexation of the Mt. Bonnell area and discussed creating a "Central Urban Redevelopment District" (CURE) to stimulate downtown development.
*   **Pioneering Public Internet:** Supported a grant for Austin Free-Net to establish free public internet access within city libraries.
*   **Pipeline Safety Concerns:** Held a public hearing to address critical public safety, health, and environmental issues regarding a proposed gasoline pipeline in South Austin.
